title: Summit Lagoon 🏔️ - 4K version threejs (Sound on - may be with headphones.. to feel the wind)
author: Efficient_Ad8214
selftext:
you can hear the sound of flutter of the parachute.. the quietness yet the magnificience of the area.  
  
A turquoise lagoon sitting in a granite bowl, high above a valley of cloud. It runs in the browser, built in Three.js.  
  
These places are haunting - The Himalayan ranges can dwarf a human to their insignificance.. and then there is the manasarovar..the very presence of which can put you in tears.. 

Made with Opus 5.5, GPT 6 Astra, ElevenLabs, TripoAI, Blender..

better as an experience than a game.. what do you think
